column1: # Provisional game profile of Yoru, Tomosu (Switch, Japanese release, base game v0), SDK 9.5.0, NVN through nn::gfx. Written from a survey of the game files with
# dm/games/profile_guess.py; the game has not been booted with it. Every key marked "guess" follows a rule or a sibling profile and is not measured. README.md beside this file.
# no pad_layout: a text adventure, the default 2D layout (guess: nothing in the files decides it)
# The display version was not read (the import keeps no control data)
# load order as on Horizon: main, sdk (the game has no subsdk). main also imports eight glslc* functions that no module of the game defines (there is no GLSLC module): with nn::gfx
# these come with the library, as in Resident Evil 4
# the file types that are big or already compressed (profile_guess.py's rule; .bfstm is the streamed sound, 0.9 GB)
# guess (profile_guess.py's rule, not measured): the NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0), so there is no virtual address memory, and main never imports
# nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize: its memory is its own bss (1,569 MB, part of the module image and counted as used memory, not part of the block below), which it hands to
# nn::mem::StandardAllocator and nn::lmem exp heaps. So the 1 GB block of a game without a heap (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 256 MB heap region),
# no mem_used: the rewritten modules without the bss are under the default 64 MB; whether anything asks for the used memory size is not known
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py: 24 BNSH files in the RomFS folder shader/, none in main) ----
# PEANUTS begin: picture shapes, untested candidates (aspect_plan, dm/host/aspect_plan.h): Game settings > Display > Fill
# NOT SEEN ON A DEVICE. Every place the ? pack's main has the packed 1920x1080 sizes in code and the 16/9 float words (a scan of the code on 2026-11-21, no community patch behind them):
# the 3D view may follow the screen, the 2D layer may not, or the game may draw wrongly or not start with Fill. Fit is unchanged. Take out the
# rows that prove wrong, and aspect_plan_untested once a device has shown the rest right (the note says what was seen).
